agent-native.rule: May remember a repository/tool pointer, never copy repository truth into personal memory.

repository-instructions.rule: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md explain how to retrieve truth; they do not duplicate the truth.

context-engine.rule: Persist only source-backed facts/relations or explicitly human-approved decisions.

deduplication: One class has exactly one owner.
Native memory stores pointers, not repository payloads.
Repository instructions store retrieval policy, not copied facts.
Why/rationale enters the context engine only through approved decision provenance.
